scope: Separate Free Update 20 / Budokai Festival event provenance from the paid Dragon Ball DAIMA Pack and establish the strongest date/content boundary supported by official release evidence.

findings.finding: Bandai Namco's official DAIMA Pack release notice states that the DAIMA Pack and its accompanying free update were released on the same date and that the free update included Skills; the official notice does not name those skills individually.

The official Bandai Namco Japan release announcement separately identifies four Budokai Festival skills in Free Update 20, but the accessible text does not expose their individual names or internal IDs.

The paid DAIMA Pack remains a separate provenance event containing six player-character skills; those six canonical mappings must not be used as substitutes for the four free-update Festival identities.

evidence_boundary.official_date: 2025-05-21 is supported by the official Bandai Namco Europe DAIMA Pack release notice for the Pack and accompanying free update.
evidence_boundary.version: Game version 1.24.0 is retained only where independently documented; this batch does not promote that version value from research metadata into the authoritative event registry without direct official version evidence.
evidence_boundary.skill_scope: Official evidence establishes four free-update Festival skills but does not expose exact internal canonical IDs.
evidence_boundary.canonical_policy: No skills.json mutation, no invented canonical IDs, and no duplicate skill→event mappings.

next: Continue substantive canonical skill provenance/mechanics enrichment outside the already-audited Festival identity gap; revisit the four Festival IDs only when exact structured historical identifiers appear.
